source: NOVA FIX bundled offline compatibility reference
disclaimer: This is a bundled offline snapshot, not live information. It may be outdated; check Offline Updates for newer compatibility packs.

windows11Requirements.tpm: 2.0 required (firmware TPM or Intel PTT / AMD fTPM)
windows11Requirements.secureBoot: Required (UEFI Secure Boot capable and enabled)
windows11Requirements.cpu: 64-bit 1 GHz+ dual-core on the supported list (generally 8th-gen Intel Core or newer, AMD Ryzen 2000 or newer)
windows11Requirements.internet: Required only for initial setup and account (out of scope for NOVA FIX offline checks)

knownNotes.appliesTo: Intel 7th generation Core (Kaby Lake), e.g. i7-7820HQ
knownNotes.text: 7th-generation Intel Core CPUs are generally NOT on Microsoft's Windows 11 supported CPU list. Systems such as the Dell Precision 7520 (i7-7xxx) will fail the official compatibility check. NOVA FIX never bypasses this check silently; it reports the bundled reference verdict with its date.

Shipped with Windows 10; TPM 2.0 present on most configurations; BIOS updates available as signed packages (import via Offline Update Manager). Quadro driver packages should be kept locally for offline reinstall.
